events.title: LunaScript cDNA conversion (ATF3 rep 3)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: LunaScript cDNA conversion (ATF3 rep 3) — done on 08-11, straight off the RNA isolation. Umut confirmed it was completed, so it was not carried into 08-12.

events.title: TCA wash (discard, wash 5x, tap dry)
events.notes: 2026-08-10 correction: previously missing — TCA fixation needs this active wash step after the passive incubation, not just the initial "add TCA" step. protocols.md SRB Assay steps 3-5. 15 min per Umut. 2026-08-10 CANCELLED: postponed to after vacation return (no specific date yet) — one of the planned cell lines died after puromycin selection; Umut will substitute from a previous replicate once back. Do not delete; regenerate SRB chain (seeding -> treatment -> TCA fixation) once a return date is picked.

events.title: qPCR prep
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Sits inside the 2 h wet transfer. Plate is fridged overnight for the 08-13 qPCR.

events.title: CuAdapt cells — passage (one-off, missed Monday)
events.notes: One-off catch-up for the passage skipped on Monday 08-10. Placed after the copper treatment (ends 13:30) with the required 10-min gap. Does not affect the recurring Mon/Thu passage schedule. 2026-08-11: marked done by Umut from the app — not carried into 08-12.

events.title: Boil protein samples — setup
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Hands-on half of the 30 min boil: calculate concentrations, add loading buffer, set the heat block. The 15 min at 95 C that follows is unattended.

events.title: Send plasmids to sequencing
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Fits exactly into the 15 unattended minutes while the samples are at 95 C, per Umut.

events.title: Western — samples at 95 °C
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Unattended 15 min of the boil. Cool on ice afterwards. Plasmids go to sequencing in this window.

events.title: Western — load gel
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Last hands-on step before the run; everything after this is unattended until the transfer is assembled.

events.title: Western — SDS-PAGE run
events.notes: 2026-08-11: A standard run, ~1.5 h. Real endpoint is the dye front reaching the bottom of the gel, so treat the clock as a guide. Virus medium change and CuAdapt copper happen in this window.

events.title: Western — assemble wet transfer
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Build the sandwich, cold buffer and ice pack, start the transfer.

events.title: Western — wet transfer (2 h)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Unattended. qPCR prep runs in this window. No antibody step can start until this finishes.

events.title: Western — block (BSA, not milk)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: 1 h at room temperature. BSA/TBS-T — milk carries endogenous biotin and would compete with the target for streptavidin.

events.title: Western — streptavidin-HRP
events.notes: 2026-08-11: 1 h at room temperature. Conjugated, so there is no secondary antibody step today.

events.title: Western — ECL + image (biotin)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Mix the substrate, 1-5 min on the membrane, image straight away — the signal fades within the hour.

events.title: Western — membrane to 4 °C
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Store in TBS-T at 4 C overnight; stripping happens tomorrow morning.

events.title: Western — strip (20 min)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Mild stripping buffer, 20 min, swapping in fresh buffer at the 10 min mark. Rinse well before blocking.

events.title: Western — primary antibody
events.notes: 2026-08-11: 1 h. Pour off and give a quick rinse at the end — the membrane then rests in TBS-T through the qPCR and the full washes pick up at 14:00.

events.title: Western — washes (after primary)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: 3 x 5 min TBS-T. Held until after the qPCR so no two hands-on steps collide.

events.title: Western — secondary antibody
